content.title: Small-Cap Financials Are Powering Ahead. The Charts Point to More.
content.summary: Small-cap financial stocks are in the driver’s seat, poised to benefit as a weakening job market increases the odds that interest rates will be cut soon. Financial stocks, meanwhile, gain because people borrow more when loans are more affordable.
